 Game Time Thread: Juventus vs. Fiorentina
 Juventus has all of 90 minutes left before the next international break arrives. But can they go head into said break with some good vibes?
 by Danny Penza Nov 8, 2026, 6:30 PM UTC Facebook 
 Link

 LECCE, ITALY - OCTOBER 25: Nick Woltemade of Juventus during the Serie A match between US Lecce and Juventus at Stadio Via del Mare on October 25, 2026 in Lecce, Italy. (Photo by Daniele Badolato - Juventus FC/Juventus FC via Getty Images) Juventus FC via Getty Images MATCH INFO
 When: Sunday, Nov. 8, 2026.
 Where: Stadio Artemio Franchi, Florence, Italy.
 Official kickoff time: 8:45 p.m. local time in Italy and across Europe, 7:45 p.m. in the United Kingdom, 2:45 p.m. Eastern time, 1:45 p.m. Central time, 11:45 a.m. Pacific time.

 STARTING LINEUP
 Juventus starting XI (4-3-3?): Vicario; Kalulu, Bremer (c), Lucumì, Cabal; McKennie, Douglas Luiz, Koopmeiners; Kolo Muani, Woltemade, Boga.
 Juventus bench: Pinsoglio; Neto; Çelik; Gatti; Kelly; Zhegrova; Alajbegović; Ekhator; Rugani; Sarr.
 Juventus manager: Luciano Spalletti
 Fiorentina starting XI (4-2-3-1): De Gea; Jimenez, Dragusin, Viery, Joao Mario; Ndour, Oulai; Mastantuono, Gonçalves, Njie; Pellegrino.
 Fiorentina bench: Lezzerini, Christensen, Dodo, Brescianini, Ranieri, Valdepenas, Beto, Gnonto, Fagioli, Mazzeo, Pirrò, Beldenti.
 Fiorentina manager: Paolo Vanoli
 Match referee: Andrea Colombo
 HOW TO WATCH
 Television: Telemundo (United States); TLN (Canada), TNT Sports 1, TNT Sports 4 (United Kingdom).
 Online/Streaming: Paramount+ , Peacock, Telemundo Deportes En Vivo, Prime Video USA (United States); DAZN Canada; fuboTV Canada (Canada); DAZN UK (United Kingdom); DAZN Italia, Sky GO Italia, NOW TV (Italy).
